entities.name: Jean-Jacques Démafouth
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Jacques Démafouth is a political leader in the Central African Republic. He is a former defense minister, presidential candidate, and is the current political leader of the APRD rebel group. He led the peace delegation of the APRD to talks with the government in December 2008.

entities.summary: Jean-Jacques Démafouth is a political leader in the Central African Republic. He is a former defense minister, presidential candidate, and is the current political leader of the APRD rebel group. He led the peace delegation of the APRD to talks with the government in December 2008.
